x-groups.title: Authentication
x-groups.description: SASL, to sign in to the brokers. Leave the mechanism unset for none.

brokers.title: Bootstrap brokers
brokers.description: Bootstrap brokers, as host:port. The client finds the rest of the cluster from them, and connects to each broker at the address the cluster advertises for it.

tls.title: Use TLS
tls.description: Connect over TLS. Implied by tlsCa and tlsCert.

tlsCa.title: CA certificates
tlsCa.description: PEM certificates to trust, instead of the system's.

tlsCert.title: Client certificate
tlsCert.description: A PEM client certificate, for mutual TLS. Needs tlsKey.

tlsKey.title: Client key
tlsKey.description: The client certificate's PEM private key, unencrypted.

tlsServerName.title: Server name
tlsServerName.description: The name to verify the brokers' certificates against, if not their host.

oneOf.title: PLAIN
oneOf.description: A user and password, sent as they are: use it over TLS. From 0.2.0, the check warns without TLS.

oneOf.title: SCRAM-SHA-256
oneOf.description: A user and password, never sent.

oneOf.title: SCRAM-SHA-512
oneOf.description: A user and password, never sent.

oneOf.title: OAUTHBEARER
oneOf.description: From 0.2.0. A token from an OAuth client-credentials grant.

oneOf.title: AWS MSK IAM
oneOf.description: From 0.2.0. Amazon MSK's IAM access control, signed with AWS credentials.

saslUsername.title: Username
saslUsername.description: The user saslMechanism authenticates as, for plain and SCRAM.

oauthTokenUrl.title: Token URL
oauthTokenUrl.description: From 0.2.0. The identity provider's token endpoint, http or https, for oauthbearer: the connector asks it for a token with the client-credentials grant, and asks again before the token expires.

oauthClientId.title: Client ID
oauthClientId.description: From 0.2.0. The OAuth client the token is for.

oauthClientSecret.title: Client secret
oauthClientSecret.description: From 0.2.0. The OAuth client's secret, sent to the token endpoint with HTTP basic authentication.

oauthScopes.title: Scopes
oauthScopes.description: From 0.2.0. Scopes to ask the token for. Empty: none, so the provider's default.

oauthExtensions.title: SASL extensions
oauthExtensions.description: From 0.2.0. SASL extensions sent with the token, such as Confluent Cloud's logicalCluster and identityPoolId.

awsAccessKeyId.title: AWS access key ID
awsAccessKeyId.description: From 0.2.0. For aws-msk-iam, with awsSecretAccessKey. Unset: the AWS SDK's default chain, such as the environment, a web identity or the instance's role. The region is the brokers', from their host names.

schemaRegistryUrl.title: Registry URL
schemaRegistryUrl.description: A Confluent-compatible schema registry. Avro and Protobuf need one.

schemaRegistryUsername.title: Registry username
schemaRegistryUsername.description: A user for the schema registry's basic authentication, which sends the password as it is: use an https schemaRegistryUrl. Unset: none.

format.title: Format
format.description: How values and keys are encoded.

oneOf.title: JSON
oneOf.description: JSON values, whose columns and types come from the records.

oneOf.title: Avro
oneOf.description: The schema registry's Avro wire format.

oneOf.title: Protobuf
oneOf.description: The schema registry's Protobuf wire format.

oneOf.title: String
oneOf.description: Each value as text, into the column value.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: The topics to offer as streams. Empty: every topic the credentials can describe, but internal ones.

topicPattern.title: Topic pattern
topicPattern.description: A regular expression topics must match to be offered.

startOffset.title: Start offset
startOffset.description: Where a partition's first read starts.

oneOf.title: Earliest
oneOf.description: The oldest record the partition keeps.

oneOf.title: Latest
oneOf.description: Records written after the first read starts.

group.title: Consumer group
group.description: The consumer group the read's offsets are committed to once checkpointed, for Kafka's tools. Default: openetl-<pipeline>.
